label: Source artifact truth
query: Show the current Source truth for LSH-KYRIBA-TREASURY-2026 by stage, including what remains in review.
answer: Lakeshore Holdings’ current Source truth for LSH-KYRIBA-TREASURY-2026 shows a full Kyriba artifact spine through commercial close, with post-BAFO decisions still under review. The remaining uncertainty is in the Executive Decision, Selection, Transition, and Value stages, which are not yet locked as final. My read LSH-KYRIBA-TREASURY-2026 is a Kyriba treasury modernization event with Source artifacts approved through: Strategy Sourcing / RFP Evaluation BAFO / commercial negotiation Why this matters Strategy→BAFO being approved means your problem framing, vendor field, evaluation, and commercial structure for Kyriba are all documented and stage-backed in Source. Executive Decision, Selection, Transition, and Value are explicitly in review / needs-review demo states, so you should not treat vendor selection, cutover plan, or value realization as “decided” in any governance or steering context yet. Decision fork Treat Kyriba as “commercially ready, pending final approval and execution” vs. Re-open Strategy/Evaluation only if new risk, competing offers, or governance feedback emerges during Executive Decision review. What I would do next 1) Pull the Kyriba Strategy and BAFO artifacts from Source to reconfirm scope, commercials, and risk positions. 2) In your next governance touchpoint, explicitly move Executive Decision and Selection either to: Approved (if no new information), or Rework (if Board/CFO/treasury raise substantive concerns). 3) Only after that, authorize creation/approval of Transition and Value artifacts (cutover plan, value tracking model) so they align with the final decision.
